import sys

data = sys.stdin.read()

# Extract all integers, including negative numbers
import re
values = list(map(int, re.findall(r'-?\d+', data)))

if len(values) < 3:
    sys.exit()

target = values[-1]
nums = values[:-1]

seen = {}

for i, num in enumerate(nums):
    complement = target - num

    if complement in seen:
        print(f"[{seen[complement]},{i}]")
        break

    seen[num] = i
